libraryStatus: Exact-named PDF located in Guild Drive; bibliographic identity verified against PubMed, publisher, and supplied title-page image on 2026-11-06. No in-depth full-file content audit completed in this pass.
bestFor: Historical evidence about clinical indications, validity, reliability, and utility of respiratory polysomnography in children, including complex pediatric populations and perioperative adenotonsillectomy context.

mappingRationale.D1A: Context for recognizing clinical histories, comorbidities, and indications leading to pediatric respiratory PSG referral.
mappingRationale.D2B: Explains why pediatric respiratory PSG may be indicated, its evidence base, and limitations; not a procedural or scoring-rule authority.

authorityBoundary: This 2011 review is evidence for indications and clinical utility, not a current scoring or ETCO2/TcCO2 technical manual. AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 (including current errata) controls pediatric staging, respiratory event scoring, and hypoventilation thresholds. AAST technical guidance supports CO2 sensor setup, calibration, signal-quality assessment, troubleshooting, and documentation. Verify newer pediatric diagnostic and treatment guidance before relying on historical recommendations. Do not interpret isolated ETCO2 numbers without reliable signal context.
